svg.data-fabric-role: cell-based fabric element (FIF), single-stage and three-stage
svg.data-fabric-scale: up to 24 COR550 (Jericho2) leaf interconnections, 96 Tbps total
svg.data-serdes-modes: PAM4/50GE and NRZ/25GE, for J+/J2C interconnect
svg.data-features-fabric: self-routing with dynamic load balancing, fabric multicast and multicast load balancing, three pipes with flexible allocation (e.g. TDM/OTN, unicast data, multicast data)
svg.data-input-dc: -36 to -72 VDC (PSU rated 48 VDC, 1300 W; -40 V to -75 V, 40 A max)
svg.data-temperature-operating: 5 C to 40 C (41 F to 104 F); -5 C to 55 C short-term, 55 C at sea level
svg.data-software: ONIE installer, open-source and commercial NOS options
svg.data-mgmt-ports: 1x RJ-45 console, 1x micro-USB console, 1x RJ-45 10/100/1000BASE-T management, 2x SFP+ 10G out-of-band, 1x USB-A 2.0 storage
svg.data-emc: EN 55032:2015+AC:2016 Class A, EN 61000-3-2:2014 Class A, EN 61000-3-3:2013, FCC Class A, VCCI Class A, CCC GB 9254-2008 Class A, BSMI CNS13438-1
